attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-detail production location reference key for an original action webtoon. Single landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG, one establishing view, no montage. The Hunter Association test arena in its basement at noon: a ROUND chamber with a continuous circular flat grey floor precisely 30 m across, tall padded grey walls, a glass observation window HIGH ON ONE SIDE, a big wall display, and rails of light embedded flush in the floor. Camera about 6 m above the floor on the west wall, a wide 22 mm view looking diagonally down across the entire circular floor toward the east wall. Show enough of the uninterrupted ellipse of the perimeter to make the round plan and large diameter clear; no stadium stands, no sports court, no central podium. Overall ceiling 9 m above floor; industrial concrete ceiling ring beams and unobtrusive ducts visible in uppermost part. Walls covered in large rectangular matte grey impact-absorbing pads up to 5 m high, soft padding has only tidy inked seams, a few broad cool cel shadows, no tufted buttons or leather shine. Upper wall band dark slate concrete. A broad rectangular observation window 8 m wide, bottom sill about 5 m above the floor, in the UPPER RIGHT/EAST wall, with dark glass mullions and a dim empty observation room suggested behind it, safely isolated above the arena. A normal 2.1 m high service door in the lower far-right padded wall beneath and slightly beyond the window, flush and safely functional. Across the curved far-left wall, a large black-bezel rectangular screen 5 m wide, its face aimed toward arena centre, all of the face completely uniform flat chroma-key PURE GREEN, RGB red=0 green=255 blue=0, hexadecimal #00FF00; zero blue, zero red, no text, no image, no reflections, no texture, no variation or color grading on the screen mask. A little speaker grille mounted beside the screen. Floor: two straight parallel paired tracks of thin neutral WHITE light, evenly spaced about 2 m apart for a construct's feet, running across the arena diameter on one coherent floor perspective; rails are narrow inlaid light strips, NOT raised train rails, not neon cyan, no letters or numbers. Floor plain matte light slate-grey, broad flat cel planes, only sparse sensible panel joints, no polished reflections. KEY LIGHT: a visible ring of cold WHITE floodlight fixtures on brackets high on the walls below the ceiling, illuminating the circular floor with a few broad grey-blue hard-edged cast shadows. Thin white light in the floor rails is secondary. Every light has an attached fixture, no general haze or bloom. Only TWO VERY TINY generic adult staff in grey uniforms, 1.75 m tall with 7.5-head long-legged proportions, both on the far floor near the 2.1 m service door: one mid-step carrying a clipboard; the other further left holding a scanner with one hand, the other hand on a belt. They stand on the floor plane, one slightly farther back and smaller; the 30 m arena diameter is about SEVENTEEN adult body heights, so the people are tiny. No training construct, monsters, summons, heroes or audience: clean empty arena for later compositing and continuity. Keep a quiet band in the upper architecture for later lettering. Crisp drawn black ink edges, full architectural detail but flat subdued cel color and matte materials, not a CG render. The attached APPROVED location key supplies V2 line-and-shadow treatment ONLY; do not copy its white training hall architecture, tall glass facades, shiny floor, or night city.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
faults: Service door appears too tall relative to adjacent adult staff.
